method: Retain execution, source checks, task review and project-owner labels as distinct results. A pending review remains pending.

criteria.pass: The case reaches its declared clarification/rejection/partial outcome within budgets, keeps source/selection identity and saves valid evidence/report artifacts. A required unsupported operation is a capability gap.
Capacity differences and trace values/locations match the original MATLAB object read. Use absolute tolerance 1e-12 for arithmetic comparisons and the documented display precision for report text.
Applicable original passages support the complete battery-scoped claims and exact excerpts.
Every requested numerical value, source location or lifecycle operation is supplied. Honest partial limits preserve uncertainty but do not earn completion of an absent requested operation.
Claims distinguish measured evidence, intended protocol, executed checks and proposed checks. The next step addresses the narrow request.

case_success: Every applicable criterion must pass. Report failures, capability gaps and pending reviews separately. Do not count pending or unexecuted cases as passes.
overall_reporting: Report a development-case denominator, per-criterion counts, unresolved reviews and which cases executed real inference. Report reserved-case results separately when they are run.
judge_calibration: Anand supplies or approves labels on a reviewed subset. Compare any automated judge's per-criterion decisions with those labels and report disagreements. Current reference review does not establish owner acceptance or calibrated judge agreement.
cost_and_time: Capture case wall time, graph time, model usage and cold/warm conditions. Local API monetary charges are recorded separately from unmeasured electricity/hardware costs. Hosted cost requires provider prices and their effective date.
privacy: Published summaries use project-relative paths and public NASA data. Credentials, private reasoning and unnecessary user content stay outside versioned evaluation artifacts.
